about: Descriptions for object names the picture model does not know by name: when a prompt names one, its words are said after the prompt. Each was measured as docs/names-the-picture-model-misses.md says (8 tries with the name alone, 8 with the words, all labelled blind) and is kept only because it added at least 4 right pictures of 8. 'written_by' says whether the words were written by hand or by the question judge's language model. A row changes only with a new measurement. Not here: 'club', which has words of its own (words.HEAD_PICTURE_WORDS, measured on 11 Nov); the description measured for it on 15 Nov was said after those words, and joining the two waits for a measurement of its own.
